name: stock-radar
description: Read the daily TradingView list of Brazilian biggest losers in the user's Chrome and register in the Stock Radar service, through its MCP tools, only the stocks with a Strong Buy analyst rating and a negative daily change. Includes status and evidence skills. Bundles a local Python bridge that forwards MCP calls to the owner's Stock Radar service over a private network; the credential stays in the macOS Keychain and is not part of the package.
